name: claude-mods
description: Mods that change Claude Code's own interface

plugins.name: backstage
plugins.description: Buttons above the prompt: rewrite your prompt in one key, verify Claude's weakest claim with a read-only scout, send one of three next prompts in one click, hand off to a fresh session

plugins.name: ripple
plugins.description: Edits collapse to one line in the conversation; a /ripple pane shows the edited files and the files that use them as a growing tree, one section per agent

plugins.name: cues
plugins.description: Small cues around the prompt: a Next step from each answer in the hint line, options that state their consequence, a start-of-session line, sparks on git push

plugins.name: wipe
plugins.description: Screen wipes for /clear and /new: black hole, fall, dust, fade, tv; /wipe <effect> plays one without clearing

plugins.name: mirror
plugins.description: Spots a spiral (the same request, the same answer or the same failing tool, three times) and offers to break the loop
